# Regenerated test fixtures

`a/family.zip` and `b/family.zip` are listed in this package's `MANIFEST.txt` but were omitted from Git by the
2026-10-07 publication rule that drops ZIP files, so `bulk_importer_test.rex` could not run from Git.

These are **regenerated** fixtures, not the originals. They are built to satisfy exactly what
`bulk_importer_test.rex` asserts: two archives with the same filename and different SHA-256, three code
members (`.cls`, `.cls`, `.py`) and one Markdown resource, with the first code member containing `::class Family`.

Regenerated by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-23. Architecture: Tom Dyer.
